text:
lina: alerting — eu-central nvme iops collapsed, gpu attach queue piling up. anyone oncall?

sre-bot: ALERT: nvme-nodepool-eu-central read p99=520ms, SMART reallocated_sectors rising on 9 nodes; attach error: ProvisionTimeout.

tom: looking now. controllers show a coordinated firmware-promote job and a deferred scrub started by storage-cron at the same time. overlap caused big small-read spikes.

arun: firmware-promote? that usually walks metadata and rebalances hotblocks — heavy reads. we shouldn't have run that during window with batch jobs.

vicky: who scheduled firmware-promote? I see it in infra-maint service; it was kicked by a dependency change after a driver push.

lina: logs from gnode-59:
```
Apr 02 03:11:02 gnode-59 storage-maint[2211]: starting firmware-promote cohort scan /scratch
Apr 02 03:11:08 kernel: nvme 0000:3b:00.0: read latency spike 28ms -> 480ms
Apr 02 03:11:40 kubelet: attach failed: ProvisionTimeout
```

tom: immediate mitigations I ran: stopped storage-maint on affected nodes, ioniced scrub processes to best-effort, and applied io.max cgroup v2 caps to the promote job.

arun: commands used (sample):
```
# stop maint loop on node
sudo systemctl stop storage-maint.service
# cap process via cgroup v2
mkdir -p /sys/fs/cgroup/promote
echo "8:0 rbps=50M r_iops=200 wbps=100M w_iops=500" > /sys/fs/cgroup/promote/io.max
# move pids into group
echo 2211 > /sys/fs/cgroup/promote/cgroup.procs
```
vicky: routing fallback: bumped regional-preference to us-west2 for new gpu attaches for 30m. ops note: this will increase cross-region egress for some workloads.

sre-bot: ACTION: storage-maint paused (by tom). in-flight promote processes moved to capped cgroup. routing pref set to us-west2 for 30m.

lina: p99 back to ~34ms on sampled nodes after caps. attach backlog draining. SMART reallocated_sectors still slightly elevated — scheduling more thorough scrubs after we stabilize.

arun: follow-ups: 1) block firmware-promote during peak attach windows, 2) add dependency check in infra-maint that queries cluster IO headroom before starting heavy metadata jobs, 3) add nvme SMART trend alert to trigger preemptive pause.

vicky: cost/cx note: regional flip estimated +15% latency/egress hit for some EU customers during 30m. acceptable tradeoff. add to postmortem.

lina: filing INFRA-8199 "prevent concurrent metadata jobs + attach surge: promote interlock + IO caps + runbook" and assigning to storage + infra-maint. include quick rollback play (systemctl stop + cgroup cap + route flip).

tom: thumbs up. I'll add an automated canary that rejects promote jobs if average iowait > X.

sre-bot: FOLLOWUP: INFRA-8199 created by lina.

lina: monitoring eu-central for 45m, will re-enable storage-maint in staged batches with caps once green :white_check_mark:
